user.title: Eccel C1 — connection mode
user.description:
Choose how Home Assistant connects to the Eccel C1 RFID reader.

**Hub (TCP server):** Home Assistant listens for incoming connections — the reader must be configured as a TCP client.

**Client:** Home Assistant connects to the reader — the reader must be configured as a TCP server.

hub.title: Configure Eccel C1 hub
hub.description: Home Assistant will listen for incoming connections from Eccel C1 readers. Configure each reader to connect to the Home Assistant IP address on the TCP port below.

client.title: Connect to Eccel C1 reader
client.description: Enter the IP address and port of the reader. Home Assistant will connect to it and read the device information.
